properties.title: California: 13,723 meters without power (ODIN's reporting utilities)
properties.summary: ODIN's reporting utilities showed 13,723 meters without power in California at 14:40 UTC, in 10 counties; most in Los Angeles County (11,231), Riverside County (789), Siskiyou County (530). Utilities: PACIFICORP, SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON CO. More than 50,000 is the size of loss DOE's form DOE-417 makes reportable (more than 50,000 customers for an hour or more); this is one reading, summed over the state, and a meter is close to but not the same as a customer. Only utilities that report to ODIN are counted, so the real number may be higher. Reported by the utilities through ODIN; Blackout does not assess the cause. Base rate: In EAGLE-I's record for 2018-2025, California had more than 50,000 customers out for an hour or more about 17 times a year (133 times in 8 years), about 2 times a year in November; half lasted about 6 hours or less, 1 in 10 more than about 2 days. EAGLE-I reads more utilities than ODIN (about 92% of US customers by 2022), so a state over the line at ODIN's reporting utilities alone is rarer still. Coverage grew over these years, so earlier years may count fewer.
